Requirement: "Make the existing automation-path approval gate default-on for plan approvals and managed and standalone poller stall recovery. Withhold automatic `/approved` when planned automation paths lack trusted exact-path grants; report missing paths and fail closed when required checks are unavailable."
Expected change site: `.github/workflows/plan.yml` (currently line 65), `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` (currently lines 677, 959, 1134, 1213, 1229), and `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` (currently line 2435).
Evidence of absence: The PR description's auto-decision AD-1 names these three sites as the flips the PR must make (`plan.yml:63`, `orchestrate_poll.yml:936`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15323`), but the PR diff contains no hunk in any of those three files. The current code at all three locations already reads `|| 'true'` / `:-true` (confirmed: `plan.yml:65`, `orchestrate_poll.yml:677/959/1134/1213/1229`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:2435`, plus the matching `--flag-enabled "${AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED:-true}"` callsites at `plan.yml:2364` and `orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15528`). `agents.d/6838-automation-path-plan-auto-approval.md` line 2 credits this PR with the flip ("default `true` since #7181"), but the credit belongs to PR #7293, whose changelog fragment `changelog.d/7293-plan-auto-approval-default-on.md` already in the tree says "`AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED` now defaults to `true`". The PR as committed therefore either re-attributes a change already shipped by #7293 or omits the code change the spec actually calls for.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

Requirement: "Add no-grant security-finding and fully granted-plan regressions; record that the former fails before the fix and passes after it."
Expected change site: `tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py` (home of the gate's `--plan-auto-approval-gate` decision) or `tests/test_plan_auto_approve_safe_state_fetch.py` (the `plan.yml`/orchestrator pipeline contract tests).
Evidence of absence: No new regression in the PR diff targets the default-flip. The only test-file changes are: (1) `_save_store` line 3606 (`env.pop("AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED", None)`) which is a passive parent-process scrub, not an assertion; (2) the two misleading opt-outs above (no-ops for ordinary-path plans); and (3) no `_managed_auto_approve_automation_path_gate_off_by_default` test referenced by the PR description's AD-1 exists anywhere in `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`. The spec line "record that the former fails before the fix and passes after it" is unmet; no test asserts the no-grant case fails with the variable `false` and passes with the variable `true` for the same fixture.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
